note: Canonical enforcement-layer manifest (HYK-129). One entry per check/hook/gate/install target named in docs/enforcement-v1.md and the HYK-129/131 design report §1.2. Read by selfcheck-inventory.mjs; never hand-edit install_targets without also updating the real settings files they describe, or the checker will report DRIFT/NOT_INSTALLED against a manifest that no longer matches production.

checks.expected_bad: HYK-tagged commit with no matching '.harness/review.md' evidence (missing for:<id>, missing verdict:approved, or reviewer is not role:REVIEW-*) -> commit rejected
checks.expected_good: HYK-tagged commit with 'for: <id>' + 'verdict: approved' + 'role: REVIEW-*' evidence -> commit allowed

checks.expected_bad: staged content containing a secret pattern gitleaks recognizes -> commit rejected locally, before CI
checks.expected_good: staged content with no secret pattern -> commit allowed
checks.known_drift_note: As of the HYK-131 round this hook is NOT installed in .git/hooks (versioned copy exists, installed copy does not) -- a known, not-yet-resolved drift this task's own scope explicitly leaves undecided (사람 확인 필요: 의도적 미설치 vs 단순 드리프트).

checks.expected_bad: CODER writes .harness/review.md (or any role writing outside its own lane) -> exit 2, reason on stderr
checks.expected_good: CODER writes a file in its own lane -> exit 0

checks.expected_bad: HARNESS_ROLE=PM writes inside the repo or a non-control-room path -> exit 2
checks.expected_good: HARNESS_ROLE=PM writes inside the control room / scratchpad -> exit 0

checks.expected_bad: a .harness/*-task.md|coder.md|review.md|verify.md work file is newer than STATUS.md by more than the grace window -> exit 1 (advisory)
checks.expected_good: STATUS.md is at least as fresh as the newest work file (within grace) -> exit 0
checks.advisory_note: Deliberately NOT promoted to ORCH-only blocking in the HYK-131 round -- see docs/enforcement-v1.md's 'Stop hook blocking self-consumption' section for why.

checks.expected_bad: a 🟢 /clear declaration with a missing/incomplete clear-safe-attest or cycle-receipt -> HARNESS_ROLE=ORCH first attempt: exit 2; every other role or stop_hook_active re-invocation: exit 0
checks.expected_good: no green declaration, or a complete attestation+receipt -> exit 0
checks.post_hyk131_note: ORCH-only blocking via stop-blocking.mjs's resolveStopBlock (role gate + stop_hook_active recursion guard + unreadable-payload UNJUDGABLE).

checks.expected_bad: STATUS §6 open-issue state disagrees with a live Linear query (staleInStatus/missingInStatus/stateDrift) -> exit 1 (advisory)
checks.expected_good: STATUS §6 matches Linear, or LINEAR_API_KEY/STATUS file/network is unavailable (fail-open) -> exit 0
checks.post_hyk131_note: Normalized from exit 2 to exit 1 in the HYK-131 round -- was never promoted to ORCH-only blocking (see docs/enforcement-v1.md).

checks.expected_bad: control room dirty-cycle (uncommitted + stale last commit) or STATUS/PHASE-HANDOFF mtime gap over threshold -> HARNESS_ROLE=ORCH first attempt: exit 2; every other role or stop_hook_active re-invocation: exit 0
checks.expected_good: control room absent/not-a-repo (vacuously ok), or clean/fresh -> exit 0
checks.post_hyk131_note: ORCH-only blocking via stop-blocking.mjs, same adapter as clear-safe-check.

checks.expected_bad: user-prompt-submit mode with PROJECT-CONTEXT.md absent, or present but its HARD CONSTRAINTS section empty/placeholder -> exit 2, decision:block
checks.expected_good: session-start mode always exit 0 (injects context, cannot block); user-prompt-submit mode with a usable card -> exit 0
checks.mode_note: Two hook_event install targets share one script; session-start never blocks (Claude Code ignores non-zero exit for that hook type), only user-prompt-submit's exit 2 is enforced.

checks.expected_bad: n/a -- purely advisory (never a bad/good gate); a missing/stale (>8d) or malformed .harness/selfcheck-report.md captured_at produces a SessionStart additionalContext warning
checks.expected_good: a fresh (<=8d) selfcheck report -- plain stdout line, no additionalContext payload
checks.self_registration_note: This entry is this check's own manifest self-registration (HYK-129 사이클3, PM 보고서 §6) -- the selfcheck tool now audits its own SessionStart wiring the same way it audits every other check, closing (partially) the 'who checks the checker' bootstrap gap. Live wiring of the settings.local.json line itself is a human/ORCH one-time step, same convention as every other hook in this document -- NOT done by this task (see docs/enforcement-v1.md's honesty note); until wired, this entry legitimately reads NOT_INSTALLED.

checks.expected_bad: n/a -- this is a doer (writes a STATUS §1 row on a 'go <task_id>' prompt), not a bad/good gate; a 'go' prompt with a resolvable task_id/role/STATUS row updates exactly that one row
checks.expected_good: a non-'go' prompt, or a 'go' prompt with an unresolvable role/task_id/STATUS row, leaves STATUS untouched (fail-open, exit 0 always)

checks.expected_bad: <role>.md's task_id doesn't match <role>-task.md's, or its DONE timestamp predates the task's dropped_at -> exit 1
checks.expected_good: task_id matches and DONE postdates dropped_at -> exit 0
checks.invocation_note: Not hook-installed anywhere -- ORCH calls this directly (`node relay-handshake.mjs <role>`) at consume time. install_targets is empty by design; ALIVE here means 'script+test exist and pass', not 'wired into a hook'.

checks.expected_bad: a B2/B3 PM task missing the pm-snapshot envelope or a required field (G5), or pm.md's snapshot_id doesn't echo the task's (G6) -> exit 1
checks.expected_good: B1/opted-out task (envelope not required), or a complete envelope + matching echo -> exit 0
checks.invocation_note: Not hook-installed -- ORCH calls this directly at PM task drop/consume time. Same 'ALIVE via script+test' posture as relay-handshake.

checks.expected_bad: an unsigned packet (승인: ☐) or malformed signature line -> exit 1 standalone / role-guard.mjs surfaces it as part of its own exit 2 when ORCH drops a task file quoting that packet
checks.invocation_note: Never installed as its own hook -- imported and called directly by role-guard.mjs's checkPacketDirective when a *-task.md write quotes a 'packet:' line. Wiring for this entry means 'role-guard.mjs still imports and calls it' (source_reference_check), not a settings file.

checks.expected_bad: an issue's reject-streak ledger (.harness/reject-streak.json) is >=2 and the next dropped .harness/coder-task.md carries no complete escalation envelope (원인 분류 + ORCH 조치>=1) -> gate exit 2
checks.expected_good: streak<2, or streak>=2 with a complete envelope, or the issue/ledger has no entry yet (streak 0 baseline) -> gate exit 0; record always exits 0 (UNJUDGABLE+fail-open on a malformed review.md or corrupted ledger, never overwrites on uncertainty)
checks.self_registration_note: HYK-133 사이클1 자기 등재, same convention as selfcheck-freshness's own entry above -- this checker audits its own manifest presence the same way it audits every other check.
checks.invocation_note: Not hook-installed -- ORCH calls `record` directly when consuming a review result (before the relay slot's review.md gets overwritten next round) and `gate` directly before dropping the next coder-task.md. Same 'ALIVE via script+test' posture as relay-handshake/pm-snapshot-gate.

checks.expected_bad: a PR whose commit-msg/relay-handshake/role-guard/status-fresh/context-inject/clear-safe-check test suite fails, or a gitleaks/POSIX-syntax finding -> job fails, PR blocked from merge
checks.expected_good: all listed suites pass, gitleaks clean, hooks/commit-msg + hooks/pre-commit pass `sh -n` -> job green
checks.known_drift_note: As of the HYK-131 round enforce.yml runs only 6 of this repo's scripts/check/*.test.mjs suites (review-gate, relay-handshake, role-guard, status-fresh, context-inject, clear-safe-check) -- controlroom-fresh, linear-sync, packet-gate, path-normalize, pm-guard, pm-snapshot-gate, worker-status-onstart, and stop-blocking are not wired into CI. This is a known, not-yet-resolved drift; this task's scope is to detect it (selfcheck-inventory.mjs's CI coverage check), not fix it (HYK-129 사이클3).
